[b][color=#ffffff][size=3]Please consider downloading my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20973](CP x AT) Shyzie's String Lights[/url]﻿ mod instead as it comes with all the same features but can be placed indoors as well since they are considered furniture in the CP version. [/s]

[b][size=3][color=#fff2cc]♡[/color] Decorative fairy string lights to build on your farm. [color=#fff2cc]♡[/color][/size][/b]

[color=#fff2cc][b][color=#fff2cc][b]✨[/b][/color]They emit light at night! ✨[/b][/color]

[b]You can also pass underneath them![/b]
[i](The Small size you can only pass under on the right side since it is only 2 tiles wide)[/i]

There are currently 13 different skins to choose from, some being animated!
The lights come in 3 different sizes, 3 different base colors (Dark/Light/Vanilla) and can be purchased from Robin as buildable structures on the farm.

You can cycle through the skin options using the building skin button in the carpenter menu at Robin's, and after building the string lights on your farm you can use the Alternative Textures paint bucket tool to change the skin.
(I included a larger picture in the Images section)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j87eRLm.png[/img]﻿﻿

[color=#ea9999][size=3][b]⚠️ When moving or demolishing the string lights you need to select the pole stands. ⚠️
For the small size string lights you must select the left pole.[/b][/size][/color]

I [i]HIGHLY[/i] recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url]﻿ with this mod so that you can place furniture/craftables/etc. on the lights in the restricted tiles.
